name: Writing Clear Subject Lines & Closings
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on writing clear subject lines & closings -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Subject: Action Needed -- Budget Approval by Friday
Subject: Quick Question About the Q3 Report
Best regards, / Kind regards, / Thanks again,
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
